color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ESM-C 600M
573M weights, frozen. 572 effective
targets cannot fine-tune that.

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Residue cache · 14 GiB
10,820 targets, encoded once.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SMILES → line graph
Each bond is a node, plus a
fingerprint and 200 properties.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LiGhT · 8 layers, width 96
Attention kept for iBAM.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Summary → 288
Three parts, never blended.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pre-training · run, NOT used
540,166 molecules, held-out loss 0.2002.
The trained model's ligand arm is
from scratch: checkpoint records
from_scratch true, no weights loaded.

div.style: color: rgb(6, 64, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The seam · one vector per bond
Two masks, not one: real-vs-padding,
and drawable-vs-not.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Summary → 3 × 160
Each part projected alone.

div.style: color: rgb(90, 58, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Assay conditions → 160
pH, temperature, IC50 tier, source.
IC50 is 72% of the corpus, and is
not a constant of the pair.

div.style: color: rgb(90, 58, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FiLM conditioning · 145,088
Knowledge and assay rescale every
residue and bond. An appended vector
can be ignored; a multiplied one cannot.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Protein → ligand
160 → 320 → 160

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Two separate weight sets.
One is not the transpose
of the other.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ligand → protein
160 → 320 → 160

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pooled by relevance · 103,044
A binding site is 20-30 residues of a
median 454, so a plain mean buries it.
Two heads score each residue, and the
scorer is exactly the mean at init.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(92, 34, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Score only the endpoint measured
Kd, Ki and IC50 are different experiments.
A measurement that does not exist gets no
stand-in value: none is representable.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Exact
Free under the lab's own repeat
scatter: 0.945 / 0.641 / 0.671.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Censored · 18.5%
Penalized for crossing the bound,
never for landing inside it.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lower-confidence
Weighted 0.25, kept apart.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pairwise rank · 0.1
Within one assay, only past
that endpoint's scatter.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Trained · 5 epochs · one seed
Val exact RMSE 1.1343, falling every
epoch: 1.3128 → 1.2405 → 1.1918 → 1.1578
→ 1.1343. Bound violations 0.717 → 0.494.
Read against the noise floor of 0.670,
not against zero.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
iBAM · unblocked
Every map per layer and head.
Residue × bond is native.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ensemble · blocked
Needs 3 seeds. Three passes
over one is refused in code.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Conformal intervals · blocked
Waits on seeds 2 and 3.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
In-domain?
Similarity to training molecules only.
An ensemble can agree confidently
about the unseen.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 34, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Benchmark lock
Refuses sealed panels when training
overlaps them. Measured, not guessed:
random 60-100%, cold-target 66-69%,
time-based 0%.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drug fishing · an evaluation
3,721 targets · 81,971 actives
1.9M decoys. Not part of the model.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Told
Target, endpoint, seed, scaffold,
and the wanted potency change.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Discrete diffusion
Corrupted by category: carbon is
not between nitrogen and oxygen.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Back to a molecule
Scaffold checked by atom mapping.
Validity before and after sanitizing.

svg.text: BINDRA · 2,590,851 trainable parameters · 5 epochs · val RMSE 1.1343
